summary: Phase 4 end-to-end testing (Simulated mode only, no keys). Backend 3/3 pass. Frontend journeys mostly pass with ONE critical regression against JRN-68: the old 'Needs you' AttentionCard tile is still rendered in the KPI row (KpiRow.jsx) despite the requirement that it be fully replaced by the briefing-stream. One probable UX race in Live-mode CallConfirmCard where notConfigured flag renders only after /api/voice/config resolves (dial button can be briefly enabled). Simulated call flow, map fallback (invalid gmapsKey -> MapLibre in ~10s), calling settings mode toggle, broker missing prompts, number persistence, and no-double-dial were all verified. Backend /api/voice/calls correctly 503s when keys are absent.

ui_bugs.issue: JRN-68 violated: the 'Needs you' tile (data-testid=attention-strip with attention-count and attention-item-* rows) still exists in the dashboard top row. Journey requires it to be removed/replaced entirely by the briefing-stream.

In Live mode, `notConfigured` is computed as `live && cfg && !cfg.configured`. While /api/voice/config is in-flight (cfg === null) the dial button is NOT disabled and call-confirm-not-configured is NOT shown, so a user can click Dial before the server-not-configured state is known. Backend still rejects with 503, but UI is misleading. Suggest defaulting notConfigured to true in live mode until cfg resolves, or disabling dial while cfg is loading.

All contact rows present: calling-number-{D-101..D-104} placeholder 'Default demo number', calling-number-{BRK-PACIFIC|BRK-DESERT|BRK-CENTRAL} placeholder 'Add phone (E.164)' and empty. Switching to Live surfaces calling-missing-{BRK-PACIFIC|BRK-DESERT|BRK-CENTRAL}. Edited D-101 to '+16093021443', reloaded -> value persisted. verified_journeys.Simulated call panel: PASS - livecall-panel single instance, livecall-mode-badge, livecall-status, livecall-steps, livecall-objective, livecall-line-* transcript, livecall-outcome-text, livecall-end/take-over, livecall-retry/livecall-run-simulated present in source.

action_items: CRITICAL (JRN-68): Remove the 'Needs you' AttentionCard tile from KpiRow.jsx (and any surrounding 'Needs you / Updates' popover/tab). The briefing-stream is the sole surface for new attention items per Phase 4 requirements. Also remove the attention-* testids once the component is deleted.

MEDIUM (JRN-64 UX): In CallConfirmCard.jsx disable call-confirm-dial while `cfg` is null in live mode, or treat null as notConfigured, so the Live-but-not-configured state is unambiguous (today the dial button is briefly clickable until /api/voice/config resolves).
Minor: on JRN-64, surface call-confirm-not-configured even when cfg is still loading if an environment hint indicates no public Vapi key is set.
critical_code_review_comments: KpiRow.jsx AttentionCard is dead product UX per Phase 4; delete the component and remove openAttention imports to avoid duplicate attention state (briefing items now carry the same decisions).

CallConfirmCard.jsx notConfigured race: `live && cfg && !cfg.configured` leaves a window where cfg is null and the Live-call dial button is enabled. Should be `live && (!cfg || !cfg.configured)` in live mode, with the dial button disabled while fetching.
voice.py _by_key is an in-memory dict for idempotency; it will leak across requests and reset on reload. Fine for the hackathon demo but noted.
mapAdapter.js uses URLSearchParams `gmapsKey` as an override which is useful for dev checks; make sure production builds strip or ignore the override param to avoid key injection via URL.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% - JRN-57/65/66/67/70 pass; JRN-68 fails (Needs you tile still present); JRN-64 partial (UI race); JRN-56/58/59/61/62/63 blocked-on-keys and out of scope

rca of the issue: JRN-68 regression RCA: BriefingStream was added as a NEW surface alongside the existing AttentionCard, but the AttentionCard JSX block in KpiRow.jsx (lines ~65-108) was never removed. Grep for 'Needs you' finds the literal string on KpiRow.jsx:71. Reproduction: open the dashboard with cleared localStorage -> top-right KPI row shows 'Needs you | 2' with attention-item-102 (Delivery at risk) and attention-item-101 (Return load ready). Fix: delete AttentionCard() from KpiRow.jsx, remove its slot from the KpiRow grid, and drop the openAttention import; verify briefing items still surface the two decisions (they do - briefing-item for Truck 102 delay and Truck 101 return load are present).
